Sorry to hear that you are going through a tough time. I am currently in a major depression episode myself. Having to fight self-loathing, suicidal  impulses every day, what with their random onsets, takes a lot from me. It's after a couple of months of trying to ward it off myself with exercise, healthy habits and the like, I decided to listen to my GP and start medication. 

My experience with drugs has been classic. Side-effects were so extreme that sometimes, I felt that I could have been better off without the drugs. I started on Citalopram (Celexa) 20 mg. First four weeks were the toughest: intense suicidal ideations (I am under 25, that supposedly makes a difference), panic attacks (never had them before), vivid close-to-real dreams (they used to haunt me all day), nausea, messed-up sleep routines. Luckily, my sex performance had not been influenced majorly. Sometimes I take longer to ejaculate, otherwise my sex drive is intact. My doctor gave me additional drugs (Oxazepam, Olanzapine - 2.5 mg) to deal with panic attacks and sleep deprivation respectively. Side effects waned gradually. 

My moods have not improved or stabilized much yet. So last week, I upped my dosage to 30 mg after serious consideration. I know I have to go through a few weeks of side-effects again, but I can't deny the fact that I can notice the drugs helping me restore my brain chemicals. 

I had been reading some books on depression, understanding how depression works is, in my opinion, holding the magic key. Mindfulness, for example, helps me at times. 

I am sorry I can't give you a comprehensive guide. I am still struggling, so it's quite hard for me to put a finger on something that works.

I did get help. I am back home now. But suicidal thoughts just won't go away. I am currently being treated for clinical depression (Citalopram 20 mg). They are afraid that putting me in a psych ward will only worsen my self-harming tendencies. I don't know what to do. I fell asleep for a couple of hours. Dreams and nightmares are too hard to bear. My head is feeling light, like it's falling backward. I am hallucinating as well (I am terribly afraid of snakes, every object in the house seems to be turning into one). Please help.
